summary: Both editions were independently reviewed against every clause of the selected Greek working source, including their notes and metadata. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. The simplified edition’s compression preserves the substantive actions, restrictions, comparisons, dialogue, and negations. Both editions retain the affectionate actions, brother/not-husband contrast with the disclosed man alternative, prayer, overnight stay, second-hour expression, supper metaphor, and unrestricted promise of explanation. The notes accurately disclose the supplied apparatus reports for the conjectured or restored readings and identify the bracketed dance phrase without silently replacing the working text. Acceptance concerns fidelity to the supplied source and honesty of disclosure, not authentication of unseen manuscripts, exhaustive collation, or unique interpretation. Any proposed replacement would require fresh review.
